name: ui-design
description: UI design delegation: the ui-design skill routes UI requests to the impeccable-ui-designer subagent, which runs every design decision through the impeccable skill (context loading, visitor modes, craft floor, detector triage, bounded verification)

interface.longDescription: Ships the ui-design skill, which delegates UI work to the impeccable-ui-designer subagent. Codex plugins do not load subagents, so install the agent into your project with apm-go or copy .codex/agents/impeccable-ui-designer.toml into .codex/agents/.
defaultPrompt: Use $ui-design to design the settings page.
Use $ui-design to review the dashboard for accessibility.
